key_insight: SANA-WM shows that a compact, 2.6B-parameter diffusion-transformer with hybrid linear attention can be natively trained to generate high-fidelity, 720p minute-long videos with precise camera control, matching much larger industrial baselines while using far less compute.
problem_solved: Long-range, high-resolution video/world modeling is prohibitively expensive and often requires very large models; SANA-WM addresses efficient minute-scale video synthesis with practical compute and open-source availability.
method: Hybrid Linear Attention: combines frame-wise Gated DeltaNet (GDN) linear operations with selective softmax attention to capture both local frame structure and global temporal context efficiently.
Diffusion-Transformer design optimized for minute-scale generation: a 2.6B-parameter architecture natively trained for one-minute outputs at 720p with mechanisms for precise camera control.

Engineering efficiencies: architectural and training choices (parameter-efficiency, hybrid attention, and diffusion scheduling) that reduce compute while retaining visual quality comparable to larger industrial models.
impact: Provides a practical, open-source world model that lowers the compute barrier for minute-scale video synthesis and controllable environment generation, enabling researchers and practitioners to prototype long-horizon video applications without massive infrastructure.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: block view showing Diffusion-Transformer backbone, GDN linear blocks, and softmax attention interleaving.
Quality vs Efficiency chart: visual comparison of SANA-WM (2.6B) against larger baselines (e.g., LingBot-World, HY-WorldPlay) on visual quality and compute cost.
Temporal sample strip: timeline of frames from a generated one-minute 720p video to illustrate long-horizon coherence and camera-control effects.
Camera-control schematic: icon/flow showing input camera parameters → model → controlled generated viewpoint sequence.
paper_title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
paper_authors: Haoyi Zhu, Haozhe Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Tian Ye, Junsong Chen
